name: Ozinexus Sticky Chat & Call Button
author: Simmi Ahuja

sections.description:
Ozinexus Sticky Chat & Call Button adds floating call and chat buttons to your site with a focus on reliability, accessibility and privacy.

Unlike many similar plugins, it includes a compact Reliability Mode to prevent “dead clicks” on desktop devices. When enabled, clicking the buttons on desktop can show a small fallback panel with copy actions and alternate contact options, helping visitors complete an enquiry even if direct links fail.

Features:
* Floating Call and Chat buttons
* Optional button labels
* Prefilled chat message support
* Show after X seconds
* Show after X% scroll
* Page targeting (show only / hide on selected URL paths)
* Text color, button shape and style presets
* Mobile-only toggle
* Optional pulse animation
* Reliability Mode (desktop fallback panel with copy actions)
* Privacy-first: no external APIs, no tracking
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install from the Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Go to “Ozinexus SCCW” in your admin menu.
  4. Configure settings and save.
sections.faq:
Can I show it only on specific pages?

Yes. Use Display Mode and enter URL paths (one per line).

Can I delay the buttons?

Yes. Use seconds or scroll percentage triggers.

Does it require an API or tracking?

No.

What is Reliability Mode?

Reliability Mode adds a compact fallback panel (desktop) with copy actions and alternate contact options to prevent dead-link clicks.

  • Added optional fallback contact page and email.
  • Improved accessibility (ARIA, keyboard close, reduced motion support).

1.1.0

  • Added text color, shape and style presets.
  • Brand-friendly default call button color.
  • Triggers and targeting improvements.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
